subject_cluster_uncertainty.method: paired participant-cluster percentile bootstrap; equal participant resampling, all sampled participant windows retained
subject_cluster_uncertainty.limits: Conditional uncertainty of these fitted models on an enriched held-out sample with only 8 subjects; not natural-population precision, training-repeat uncertainty, multiplicity-adjusted evidence, or a continuous-use false-action rate.

comparison.scope: AI probability threshold 0.5 specified before scoring; no test threshold tuning. Sample-enriched observed transmissions only; predictive uncertainty conditional on the fixed selected models.

history.selection: binary primary endpoints only; original probabilities and record IDs unchanged

analysis_scope: Exploratory descriptive comparison of already recorded test outputs, after earlier test results. Fixed threshold0.5, 1000 paired observation-participant bootstrap draws, eight UniBa groups. No repeated-training or multiplicity correction.
matched_comparison: New SSL-adapted CBraMod versus original CBraMod keeps alignment data, batch32, 30epochs/900s, seed, loss, token mapping, frozen Smol backbone and projection structure unchanged; only encoder weights change. One training run does not establish a general causal benefit.
